test_title: PYST 32: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven people, B, C, D, I, J, K and L, are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre of the table. I sits fourth to the right of J. Only two people sit between B and C, when counted from the left of B. D sits third to the left of K. L is an immediate neighbour of K and C. How many people sit between I and L, when counted from the left of L?
solution:
**Given: **Seven people, B, C, D, I, J, K and L, are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre of the table.

1. D sits third to the left of K.

2. L is an immediate neighbour of K and C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b243c10c2f72eaed632cc5eb57459a2606b99427f02dbf91c1ee43f76054abf.png] 

3. Only two people sit between B and C, when counted from the left of B.

The above statement cannot be satisfied in case II, so it is eliminated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95e556b14471dff83fe41c0019caebdf5cb2dcdf278f703bc8582b8be5c1a485.png] 

4. I sits fourth to the right of J.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/63b199c9720d86e7f0af8bc8bd22d964fd5016502ccdbf270ba2e3b6054ab3d7.png] 

Thus, four people sit between I and L, when counted from the left of L.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
